description:
Point all Stacks API requests at a custom node instead of the default Hiro API.
Use this if you run your own stacks-blockchain-api node (default port 3999) or use a third-party provider.
The URL should serve the same /v2/ and /extended/v1/ endpoints as api.hiro.so.
Example: http://localhost:3999

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

url.description: Base URL of your Stacks API node (e.g. http://localhost:3999)

name: set_stacks_api_url
